import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static int K;
    static List<Long> num = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<List<Long>>> trans;
    static List<List<List<List<Long>>>> base = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<List<List<Long>>>> pref = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<List<List<Long>>>> suf = new ArrayList<>();
    static long answer;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        while (N != 0) {
            num.add(N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            base.add(new ArrayList<>());
            pref.add(new ArrayList<>());
            suf.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
                base.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
                pref.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
                suf.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        // Initialize base[0][i]
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            List<List<Long>> matrix = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                    row.add(0L);
                }
                matrix.add(row);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                matrix.get(j).set(j, 1L);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                matrix.get(j).set(i, 1L);
            }
            base.get(0).set(i, matrix);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < num.size(); i++) {
            int idx = i - 1;
            // pref[i-1][0]
            pref.get(idx).set(0, deepCopyMatrix(base.get(i - 1).get(0)));
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                pref.get(idx).set(j, multiplyMatrices(pref.get(idx).get(j - 1), base.get(i - 1).get(j)));
            }
            // suf[i-1][K-1]
            suf.get(idx).set(K - 1, deepCopyMatrix(base.get(i - 1).get(K - 1)));
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suf.get(idx).set(j, multiplyMatrices(base.get(i - 1).get(j), suf.get(idx).get(j + 1)));
            }
            // base[i][0]
            base.get(i).set(0, deepCopyMatrix(pref.get(idx).get(K - 1)));
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                base.get(i).set(j, multiplyMatrices(suf.get(idx).get(j), pref.get(idx).get(j - 1)));
            }
        }

        // Initialize trans
        trans = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            List<List<Long>> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            row.set(i, 1L);
            trans.add(row);
        }

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = num.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int x = num.get(i).intValue();
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                trans = multiplyMatrices(trans, base.get(i).get(sum));
                sum++;
                if (sum >= K) sum -= K;
            }
        }

        answer = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            answer += trans.get(K).get(i);
            answer %= INF;
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }

    static List<List<Long>> multiplyMatrices(List<List<Long>> a, List<List<Long>> b) {
        int size = K + 1;
        List<List<Long>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            res.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                    sum += a.get(i).get(k) * b.get(k).get(j);
                }
                res.get(i).set(j, sum % INF);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static List<List<Long>> deepCopyMatrix(List<List<Long>> matrix) {
        List<List<Long>> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Long> row : matrix) {
            copy.add(new ArrayList<>(row));
        }
        return copy;
    }
}
